Alert.description: A message in the page: what happened or what to know, in its tone, with an optional action.

props.name: action
props.doc: A button or link at the end (Retry, Upgrade).

props.name: onClose
props.doc: Shows a close button that calls it.

Avatar.description: A person's picture, or their initial on a tint when there is none.

Badge.description: A small count or status beside a label (records in a view, a beta mark).

BarSeparator.description: A hairline between groups of controls in a row.

Breadcrumb.description: Where the page sits: its parents (links in `title`) and then itself.

Button.description: A button. Its `className` adds to Tessera's, so a host can adjust one button's layout.

props.name: size
props.doc: Without `size` a button keeps the editor chrome's 30px.

props.name: iconOnly
props.doc: A square button holding only an icon; give it an `aria-label`.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Shows a spinner before the label and marks the button busy, while its action runs.

ButtonLink.description: A link that looks like a button: for navigation (another page, a sign-in URL, a mail link) drawn as an action.

props.name: render
props.type: (props: AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement> & { className: string; children?: ReactNode }) => ReactNode
props.doc: Draws the link another way: a router passes its own (`(props) => <Link to="/" {...props} />`).

Card.description: A product card: 12px radius, a hairline, a light shadow.

Checkbox.description: A check box with its label.

Choice.description: A drop-down choice with its label before it.

props.name: quiet
props.doc: Draws no visible label (the drop-down still has `label` as its name).

ColorGrid.description: A grid of color swatches; `onPick` gets `#RRGGBB`.

props.name: onChange
props.doc: Called on every pointer move and arrow key (`final: false` mid-drag, one `final: true` on release or key).

props.name: uiId
props.doc: A Kit UI id when the picker is a declared element.

props.name: value
props.doc: The offset, `[x, y]`, y up, of length at most 1.

props.name: label
props.doc: Shown above the wheel, and its accessible name.

props.name: size
props.doc:
The wheel's side in CSS pixels (120 by default, upstream's largest). The control is `size + 18`
px wide: the lightness strip (16 px and a 2 px gap) sits outside the wheel, where upstream draws
it inside the wheel's square. To fit upstream's row of three wheels (Film's Lumetri Color
Wheels, Task 29), pass `size = min((available - 24) / 3, 120) - 18`.

props.name: uiId
props.doc: The wheel's Kit UI id.

props.name: lightnessUiId
props.doc: The lightness slider's Kit UI id.

Combobox.description: One choice from a long list, searched as the person types; the choice can be cleared.

props.name: onSearch
props.doc: Search on the server: called with each query, and the options shown are the caller's. Without it, the options are filtered here.

props.name: emptyText
props.doc: Shown when nothing matches.

props.name: label
props.doc: The control's accessible name.

Command.description: A searchable list of commands or choices (cmdk): type to filter, arrows and Enter to pick.

CommandShortcut.description: A shortcut at the end of a command item.

ConfirmProvider.description: Lets `useConfirm` ask from anywhere inside it; asks queue and show one at a time.

ContextMenu.description:
A menu at a point (a row's right-click menu): open while `at` is set, kept inside the window,
its first row focused (Up, Down, Home, and End move through the rows; the focus goes back where
it was when it closes), and closed through
`onClose` by a press outside it, Escape, or a choice in it (a `MenuItem`, any button). Its rows
are `MenuItem`s and `MenuSeparator`s, as in `MenuButton`.

props.name: kind
props.doc: 'rgb': a square with protected end points; 'hue': periodic in x, a hue strip below, 0.45 aspect.

props.name: samples
props.doc: The curve's samples to draw (0..1 over x), given by the caller; `sampleCurve`'s by default.

props.name: color
props.doc: The line and points' CSS colour; the theme's text colour by default.

props.name: label
props.doc: The plot's accessible name ("Curve" by default).

DateTimeInput.description: A date, or a date and time, from the platform's picker; cleared to `null`.

props.name: value
props.doc: Optional inside a `FormItem`, which supplies it.

props.name: withTime
props.doc: Asks for a time too.

Descriptions.description: Labelled values of one record (an order, a user), laid out in `columns` columns.

props.name: onEscape
props.doc: Called for Escape in place of `onClose` (a dialog that lets a field keep its own Escape).

props.name: modal
props.doc:
Blocks the page behind a backdrop (the default), where a press outside closes it. With
`false` the page stays usable: no backdrop, and the editor keeps its keys.

props.name: position
props.doc: Where the dialog's top left sits in the window (with `onMove`); null or absent: where the layout puts it.

props.name: onMove
props.doc:
Makes the dialog movable by its title: a drag moves it, and its place is reported once, on
release (keep it, and give it back as `position`). Absent, the title does not move it.

Disclosure.description: A section that opens and closes under its title.

props.name: open
props.doc: Open, when the screen holds the state (with `onOpenChange`).

props.name: onClose
props.doc: Called when the person closes it.

Divider.description: A hairline between sections, with an optional label in it.

props.name: kit
props.doc: Remembers the layout per kit, in the kit's store (`kit:<kit>:dock`, see `kitStore`).

props.name: shown
props.doc: Groups the Window menu shows; others are not drawn.

props.name: handle
props.doc: Receives the dock's `DockAreaHandle`.

Element.description:
Content that belongs to one element: not drawn when hidden; its form controls disabled when
disabled. A `fieldset` disables every control inside it without each control knowing.

Empty.description: Nothing to show yet: a quiet drawing, what is missing, and what to do about it.

props.name: image
props.doc: Replaces the inbox drawing (an icon of the situation).

props.name: children
props.doc: Actions under the text (Create, Retry).

EyeButton.description:
A row's eye: the eye icon while shown, an empty box while hidden (as Photoshop draws it).
A press toggles at once (`onPress` hears whether Alt was held); with `sweep`, dragging on from
the press down the eye column (mouse, pen, or touch) reaches every other eye of the group the
pointer crosses, through `sweep.onOver`, so the panel gives each the visibility the first press
set. A keyboard click toggles too. It is pressed while its row shows; `tabIndex` takes it out of
the tab order where a list moves the focus itself.

Field.description: A label, a control, and its help or error, wired together for screen readers.

props.name: hint
props.doc: Help under the control; replaced by `error` when there is one.

props.name: children
props.type: ReactNode | ((ids: { id: string; describedBy: string | undefined; invalid: boolean }) => ReactNode)
props.doc: The control. Given a function, it receives the ids to put on it (`id`, `aria-describedby`).

FloatingPanels.description:
The floating windows layer (see the module's comment). Render it inside an element with a
non-static `position` (`relative`) that covers the area the windows may use: the layer fills
that element and keeps every window inside it.

props.name: store
props.doc:
Store name for positions and sizes (`useKitStore`). It holds the windows' rectangles only:
anything else under it is dropped on read, so a kit keeps its own list of open windows under
a different name.

props.name: panels
props.doc: The open windows, bottom to top as first opened. Keep the array and each `render` stable (`useMemo`, `useCallback`).

props.name: focused
props.doc: The window the kit treats as focused (drawn as such and raised); null for none.

props.name: onFocus
props.doc: A press or focus inside a window.

props.name: defaultSize
props.doc: A new window's size (upstream's `default_size`, 520 × 360).

props.name: minSize
props.doc: The smallest a window resizes to (upstream's `min_size`, 320 × 220).

Form.description: A form that keeps its fields' values and checks them before `onFinish`.

props.name: initialValues
props.doc: The values it starts with (read once).

props.name: onFinish
props.doc: Called with the values when the person submits and every field passes.

props.name: layout
props.doc: `vertical` (default): labels above controls; `inline`: fields in a row (filters).

FormItem.description: A labelled control bound to one field of the form around it, with its rules and error.

props.name: name
props.doc: The field's name in the values; without it the item only lays out a label and a control.

props.name: extra
props.doc: Help under the control (replaced by the error while there is one).

props.name: required
props.doc: Marks the label as required (implied by a `required` rule).

props.name: valuePropName
props.doc: The control's prop that holds the value: `checked` for a check box or switch.

props.name: trigger
props.doc: The control's prop that reports a change: `onCheckedChange` for a switch.

props.name: getValueFromEvent
props.doc: The value from what the control reports (an event's `target.value` or `checked`, or the value itself, by default).

props.name: dependencies
props.doc: Fields whose changes re-check this one (a confirmation of a password).

props.name: hidden
props.doc: Kept in the values but not drawn.

props.name: children
props.doc: One control element.

props.name: softMin
props.doc: The track's range (upstream's `soft_min`/`soft_max`); `min` and `max` by default. The hot text reaches `min`..`max`.

props.name: decimals
props.doc: Decimals a value is rounded to (0 by default).

props.name: default
props.doc: Restored by a double-click on the track; no double-click without it.

props.name: stops
props.doc: CSS gradient stops for the track (Temperature, Tint, Hue; see `SLIDER_GRADIENTS`); a plain track when absent.

Hint.description: A muted usage hint in a row.

props.name: bins
props.doc: Bin counts (256 for an 8-bit channel), left (shadows) to right (highlights).

props.name: color
props.doc: A CSS color for the bars; the element's own (inherited) color by default.

props.name: smooth
props.doc: Draws the bins through upstream's five-bin display kernel (`smoothHistogram`), as its Camera Raw histogram does.

props.name: scale
props.doc:
What the bars are scaled to: `interior`, the interior bins' maximum (the default, see
`scaleFor`), or `rank`, upstream's Histogram panel and tone editors (`tone.rs`
`draw_histogram`): the 251st-smallest of 256 bins, so a handful of spikes (pure white, pure
black) are clipped instead of flattening the rest. Either with 10% headroom.

props.name: start
props.doc: Visible range in seconds and the lane's width map times to x.

props.name: onMove
props.doc: Called once on release with the dragged ids and the time delta.

props.name: fps
props.doc: Frames per second: an arrow key moves the selected keyframes one frame (30 by default).

props.name: onMenu
props.doc: A keyframe's menu was asked for at a screen point (upstream's interpolation menu).

props.name: uiId
props.doc: The Kit UI id every keyframe carries (`control:effects.keyframe`).

props.name: peaks
props.doc: Current peak per channel, linear 0..1+ (above 1 clips).

props.name: floor
props.doc: dB at the bottom of the scale (upstream meters: -60).

props.name: holds
props.doc: Peak hold per channel, linear.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Channel captions under the bars ("S" "S" in upstream's solo buttons row, or "L" "R").

props.name: ref
props.doc: Draws live levels without a React render.

LineChart.description: Lines of one or more series over ordered categories, with a legend and a hover readout.

props.name: xField
props.doc: The field of each datum on the horizontal axis (categories in order of first appearance).

props.name: yField
props.doc: The field holding the number.

props.name: seriesField
props.doc: The field naming the series a datum belongs to; one series without it.

props.name: label
props.doc: The chart's accessible name.

MenuButton.description:
A button that opens a menu below it; the menu takes the focus, and gives it back to the button
when it closes. With `placement` `auto` (a button along a panel's bottom), the menu opens above
the button when it does not fit below and there is more room above.

MenuItem.description:
A menu row. With `checked` set (true or false) it is a toggle: a check mark shows in the icon's
place while it is on (the state wins over the icon), and assistive technology hears it as a
checkbox item.

Modal.description: A modal dialog. Controlled with `open` and `onOpenChange`; Escape and an outside press close it.

ModalBody.description: The content between a modal's header and footer; it scrolls in a `fixed` modal.

ModalCloseButton.description:
The close button in a modal's corner. ModalContent draws one; with `hideClose`, place your own,
for one you can disable (`disabled` while an import runs).

ModalContent.description: The dialog's panel, over a dimmed page: 12px radius, a hairline, the modal shadow.

props.name: size
props.doc: Its widest: `xs` 320px to `4xl` 896px; `none` leaves the width to `className`.

props.name: hideClose
props.doc: No close button in the corner (the footer has its own way out).

props.name: dismissible
props.doc: When false, an outside press does not close it (Escape still does).

props.name: disableAutoFocus
props.doc: Keeps focus where it was instead of moving it into the dialog when it opens.

props.name: fixed
props.doc: A long dialog: the header and footer stay put with hairlines, and `ModalBody` scrolls between them.

ModalFooter.description: The actions at the bottom of a modal, right-aligned; full width on a narrow window.

ModalHeader.description: The title and description at the top of a modal.

MultiSelect.description: Several choices from a list: the chosen ones in the field, toggled in a list (searchable once it is long).

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Shown when nothing is chosen.

props.name: label
props.doc: The control's accessible name.

NavMenu.description: An app's sidebar: its pages as links, grouped under headings, the current one marked.

props.name: items
props.doc: Pages, or groups of pages under a heading.

props.name: selectedKey
props.doc: The current page's key.

props.name: collapsed
props.doc: Icons only, each page's label in its tooltip (a collapsed sidebar).

props.name: renderLink
props.type: (href: string, props: AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement> & { children: ReactNode }) => ReactNode
props.doc: Draws a link; a router passes its own (`<Link to={href} … />`). A plain `<a>` by default.

props.name: name
props.doc:
The field's accessible name and tooltip when `label` is a symbol rather than words
(Photoshop's Character panel labels its fields with glyphs: tT, A↕, VA); `label` by default.

props.name: step
props.doc: Step for arrows and scrubbing; decimals shown follow it (1 → integer).

props.name: onChange
props.doc: Called while scrubbing with `final: false`, and once with `final: true` on release, Enter, or blur.

props.name: uiId
props.doc: A Kit UI id when the field is a declared element.

props.name: track
props.doc: A slider row: the label and field on one line, a slider from `min` to `max` under them.

props.name: hot
props.doc:
Hot text (Premiere's, upstream Film's `widgets::hot_number`): the value and its unit drawn as
accent text, without a box or a visible label (`label` names it). Dragged sideways it scrubs
by `speed` per CSS pixel (Shift ten times faster, Cmd, Ctrl, or Alt ten times finer), reporting
`final: false` per move and the last value again with `final: true` on release; a click opens
a field to type into, which commits on Enter or blur and leaves unchanged on Escape.

props.name: speed
props.doc: Hot text: value units per CSS pixel dragged (`step` by default).

props.name: onDone
props.doc: Hot text: called once a typed edit ends (Enter, Escape, or blur), so the editor can take the focus back.

NumberInput.description: A field for a number, empty as `null`; arrows step it, and it rounds to `precision` when left.

props.name: value
props.doc: Optional inside a `FormItem`, which supplies it.

props.name: precision
props.doc: Decimals kept when the field is left.

OverflowStrip.description:
A row that scrolls sideways when its content does not fit (the ribbon's groups, a tool's options
bar): the cut edge fades, and a button there scrolls by most of a width. `className` and
`panelClassName` add to the outer box and the scrolled row; `resetKey` (the shown tab, the active
tool) re-measures; the buttons' test ids are `${testId}-start` and `${testId}-end`.

props.name: panelRef
props.doc: The scrolled row, for a caller that measures it (the frame's step-down).

Pagination.description: The pages of a long list: the range shown, page buttons, and an optional page size.

props.name: pageSizeOptions
props.doc: Offers these page sizes; without it the size is fixed.

PanelFooter.description: The buttons along a list panel's bottom, as Photoshop's: `start` on the left, `end` on the right.

PasswordInput.description:
A password field with a show/hide button; the button keeps out of the tab order. `className`
goes on the field itself, as on TextInput.

props.name: prefix
props.doc: An icon (or short text) inside the field before the text: a search glass, a person.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.doc: Classes for the box around the field and its show/hide button (layout: width, margins).

Popconfirm.description: Asks "are you sure?" next to the button that does something, before it does.

props.name: danger
props.doc: Draws OK as a destructive button.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Lets the trigger act without asking.

props.name: children
props.doc: The button that asks.

Popover.description: Floating content anchored to a trigger: filters, pickers, small forms.

PopoverContent.description: The popover's panel: 12px radius, a hairline, the floating shadow; 288px wide unless `className` says otherwise.

props.name: preview
props.doc: Shows the Preview check box (on at first) when given; without it the dialog behaves as `Dialog`.

props.name: hideOk
props.doc: Draws no OK: one button (Cancel, named by `cancelLabel`) for a dialog that only shows information.

props.name: onOk
props.doc:
Runs the command. The dialog does not close itself: once this resolves, the kit unmounts it
(unless `keepOpen`). A failure shows in the dialog and leaves it open, previewing again.

props.name: onCancel
props.doc: Cancel, Escape, or a press outside (when modal). The kit unmounts the dialog. Not while OK runs.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.doc: The Cancel button's label ("Done" in upstream's Find, "Close" for information).

props.name: onReset
props.doc: Alt turns Cancel into Reset, which calls this (restores the dialog's defaults).

props.name: keepOpen
props.doc: OK runs without closing, and the preview stays open (upstream's Find).

props.name: modal
props.doc:
Blocks the page (the default). With `false` there is no backdrop: a press outside does not
cancel, Tab may leave the dialog, and the editor keeps its keys (to move the playhead under a
picture preview). Escape still cancels.

props.name: uiId
props.doc: The dialog's Kit UI id.

props.name: ids
props.type: { ok?: string; cancel?: string; preview?: string }
props.doc: The buttons' Kit UI ids; Reset is the Cancel button.

props.name: position
props.doc: Where the dialog sits (with `onMove`), as `Dialog`'s; absent: where the layout puts it.

props.name: onMove
props.doc: Makes the dialog movable by its title, as `Dialog`'s (a kit keeps the place); absent, it does not move.

RenameField.description:
A row name's in-place editor, focused with its text selected: Enter or leaving it commits,
Escape cancels (`onDone` once, with which); a composing input method keeps Enter for itself.
It keeps its presses and keys from the row (no selection change, no editor shortcut).

Result.description: The outcome of a whole page or flow (paid, access denied, page not found), with what to do next.

props.name: swatch
props.doc: A colored mark under the icon (font color, fill).

props.name: primary
props.doc: Shown in Single line's row (small); the group's other items wait in its popover.

props.name: lineLabel
props.doc: In Single line's row, keep the label beside the icon; a primary item with an icon otherwise shows the icon alone there (its label stays its name and tooltip).

RibbonGroup.description:
A ribbon group. With an `id` (`group:<tab>/<group>`, or an engine menu path `menu:<Menu>/<Group>`
for groups built from commands) it follows the UI configuration and ends with the host's
buttons for it. In Single line it shows its primary items and a popover with the rest; `icon`
marks the one button a group without primary items becomes there.

RibbonItem.description:
Any content in a ribbon group that is not a ribbon button (a field, a gallery): `primary` shows
it in Single line's row too; otherwise it waits in the group's popover there.

RibbonStack.description: Small buttons stacked in up to three rows; in a Single line group, its primary buttons in the row.

Segmented.description: Buttons of which one is pressed: icons (selection modes, alignment) or words (24h, 7d, 30d).

props.name: label
props.doc: The group's accessible name (for example "Selection mode").

props.name: testId
props.doc: Each button's test id is `${testId}-${value}`.

Select.description:
A drop-down. It stays a native select, as kits' do, for the platform's popup and accessibility,
drawn as Tessera's control. Children are `<option>`s.

Sheet.description: A panel that slides in from the right over a dimmed page, for editing one thing beside the work.

props.name: footer
props.doc: Actions at the bottom, right-aligned.

props.name: dirty
props.doc: With unsaved changes, closing (Escape, the backdrop, the close button) calls `onRequestClose` instead.

props.name: width
props.doc: Its width in pixels.

props.name: label
props.doc: Its accessible name, when `title` is not plain text (a logo and a name).

props.name: side
props.doc: The edge it slides in from: `right` (default, editing beside the work) or `left` (an app's navigation on a phone).

props.name: testId
props.doc: Test id of the sheet; its parts take `${testId}-backdrop`, `-header`, `-close`, `-footer`.

Skeleton.description: A placeholder in the shape of content that is loading; `lines` draws a paragraph. Size it with `width` and `height`, or with classes (16px tall by default).

Spinner.description: A spinning circle for work in progress; `label` names it for screen readers (otherwise it is decorative).

Switch.description: An on/off switch for a setting that applies at once. Controlled with `checked` and `onCheckedChange`.

Table.description:
Records in rows and columns: `columns` say what each shows (`dataIndex`, `render`), `dataSource`
holds the records. Pages through long lists, shows a spinner while loading and `emptyText` when
empty, and can pin columns and the header.

props.name: rowKey
props.doc: The field that identifies a record, or a function of it.

props.name: pagination
props.doc: Pages of `defaultPageSize` rows (10 by default); `false` shows every row.

props.name: size
props.doc: `small`: 36px rows for dense screens; `middle` (default): 44px.

props.name: emptyText
props.doc: Shown when there are no rows (an `Empty`).

props.name: sticky
props.doc: Keeps the header in view while the page scrolls.

props.name: scrollX
props.doc: The table's least width; it scrolls sideways in a narrower container.

props.name: caption
props.doc: Caption above the table, for its accessible name.

TableSizePicker.description: Choosing a table's size by pointing at a grid of cells (Insert > Table).

Tabs.description: Sections of one page under a row of tabs; arrow keys move between tabs.

props.name: activeKey
props.doc: The open tab, when the screen holds it (with `onChange`); otherwise `defaultActiveKey` or the first.

props.name: extra
props.doc: Content at the end of the tab row (a filter, an action).

Tag.description: A short status or category label on a soft tint of its tone.

TextInput.description: A single-line text field. `invalid` marks it (and `aria-invalid`) after a failed check.

props.name: prefix
props.doc: An icon (or short text) inside the field before the text: a search glass, a person.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.doc: Classes for the box around the field and its prefix (layout: width, margins).

Thumbnail.description:
A thumbnail: `image` fitted in a `size` × `size` cell at its own aspect, over a checkerboard
where it is transparent, with a thin frame; an empty cell while there is no image (not drawn
yet, or its source could not draw one).

TimecodeField.description:
A timecode readout: `value` (seconds) shown as timecode at `fps`. With `onChange` it scrubs
(one frame per 2 px, reported with `final: false`, then once with `final: true` on release) and
a click turns it into a text field (`parseTimecode`'s forms; Enter or blur commit with
`final: true`, Escape or text that is not a time reverts). Without `onChange` it only shows.

props.name: value
props.doc: Seconds.

props.name: onChange
props.doc: Called while scrubbing (`final: false`) and once on release, Enter, or blur.

props.name: accent
props.doc: Upstream's accent-coloured playhead timecode.

TooltipContent.description: The tooltip's bubble: dark, small, above the page.

TooltipProvider.description: Shares one hover delay among the tooltips inside it (`delayDuration`, 200 ms by default).

TransportBar.description:
The buttons in `buttons`' order, centred. A button's `testId` is `<testId>-<id>`; one whose
Kit UI id the configuration hides is left out, and one it disables is disabled.

props.name: panels
props.doc: Keep this array, and each panel's `render`, stable across renders (see above).

props.name: maximized
props.doc:
The maximized panel fills the area without changing the tree (upstream `keys.maximized`, the
` and Shift+` keys). The panel menu's Maximize Frame, as upstream, replaces the tree instead.

props.name: onRestore
props.doc: Restore Workspace in the panel menu.

ZoomControl.description: Zoom out, a slider from `min` to `max`, zoom in, the value, and fit.

props.name: labels
props.type: { out: string; in: string; fit: string }
